parsed.text: Panel p0 gives fallible 4×4 location distributions for red and blue roles at nodes n0–n3 (rows increase downward, columns rightward). Current p0 distributions (represented_time 12) for both roles at all four nodes are uniform across the 16 cells; these are copied/inherited prior records, not new estimates. Candidate (conditional) command records k0, k1 and k2 present alternative, conditional estimates (not executed events). Most candidate nodes remain uniform, but node n2 varies by command: under k0 blue mass concentrates on cells (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3) while red mass concentrates on (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1); under k1 n2 is uniform; under k2 blue is sharply peaked at (0,2) and red sharply peaked at (0,1). Candidate n2 estimates are recorded as command_estimate entries with feedback_through 11 and represented_time 13.
